name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
description: As a prophecy of doom unfolds on the peaceful land of Britannia, a purehearted boy sets out on a journey of discovery — and revenge.

videos.title: Recap
videos.overview: Special recap of the first 11 episodes of the anime.

videos.title: THE BOY'S DEPARTURE
videos.overview: As Percival turns sixteen, his grandfather tells him about the big world beyond their far-flung home — but the young man seems more interested in dinner.

videos.title: THE UNKNOWN FORCE
videos.overview: On a journey to find his estranged father, Percival comes across a group of traveling performers who give him a lift to the nearest village.

videos.title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS OF THE APOCALYPSE
videos.overview: Although Percival puts up a good fight, the black knight hasn't unleashed his full powers yet. Suddenly, a mysterious red fox appears.

videos.title: THE DEMON OF ECHO GORGE
videos.overview: Percival wakes up to find himself tied up and experimented on. His captor tells him that he's almost perfected the medicine he's been developing.

videos.title: A RESOLVE FURTHER HONED
videos.overview: To return his grandfather to his original form, Nasiens will have to defeat another Holy Knight, and Percival is determined to help.

videos.title: SISTANA SHAKEN
videos.overview: Percival and his friends come across a fierce young woman named Anne who, against her father's will, dreams of becoming a Holy Knight.

videos.title: THE NAME OF THE MAGIC
videos.overview: Although Ironside completely overpowers them, Percival, Anne and Nasiens put up a brave fight. But Donny is nowhere to be seen.

videos.title: YOUNG HEROES
videos.overview: While Percival and crew struggle to destroy the Coffin of Eternal Darkness, a powerful mysterious ally faces the monsters raiding the town.

videos.title: MASTER AND PUPIL
videos.overview: The group — now joined by an exuberant Anne — make a stop in the rough town of Cant, where Donny has an awkward family reunion.

videos.title: ROAR OF DESTRUCTION
videos.overview: While held captive, Howzer, Nasiens and the others find out that Edlin has stolen a dragon's egg, putting the whole town in danger.

videos.title: A REAL HOLY KNIGHT
videos.overview: As Percival, Donny and Anne have their hands full trying to stop the rampaging dragon, the still drunk Howzer asks Nasiens to sober him up.

videos.title: A SINISTER ENDEAVOR
videos.overview: On the way to Liones Kingdom, Sin experiences a peculiar dream. The next morning, despite a passerby's warning, the crew stumbles upon a strange village.

videos.title: THE CORNERED
videos.overview: Percival faces off against Kellie, a powerful and merciless mythical beast. The crew chases Ardbeg into a mysterious cave, only to find out it's a trap.

videos.title: THE GOAT SIN
videos.overview: Ardbeg's magic transforms Percival and his crew into helpless babies. The elder of the demon clan village comes to their rescue, presenting an ultimatum.

videos.title: THE DARK TALISMANS
videos.overview: Arthur's men, hiding in the distance, ambush Gowther and Ardbeg. Restored to their original forms, Percival and his crew continue their perilous journey.

videos.title: DEPARTING FROM SIN
videos.overview: Percival and his crew go head-to-head with the Dark Talismans. However, Fiddick devises a plan to defeat the young crew's source of strength.

videos.title: THE KING OF LIONES
videos.overview: Arriving at Liones Kingdom, Percival and his crew head to the castle to meet the king. But they find him absent, and soon Percival strays into trouble.

videos.title: KIGHTS OF PROPHECY MEET
videos.overview: The former king has an ominous dream about the Four Knights. Percival and his crew are introduced to Tristan and set off in search of the fourth knight.

videos.title: LIONES IN FLAMES
videos.overview: A mysterious girl appears before Lancelot, delivering a prophecy. Meanwhile, a hostile drunkard provokes a fight with a Ruby Holy Knight.

videos.title: TAMING A WILD HORSE
videos.overview: The Four Knights of Apocalypse finally gather together in one place. However, they can't agree on how to handle Pellegarde — until Percival steps in.

videos.title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS VS THE SERVANTS OF CHAOS
videos.overview: Under Arthur's orders, powerful members of the demon clan wreak havoc in the kingdom. Meliodas seeks to uncover the truth behind King Arthur's motives.

videos.title: FREEZING, BURNING HEARTS
videos.overview: The Four Knights collaborate to combat the servants of Chaos. Meanwhile, sensing imminent danger, Lancelot makes his way to the castle.

videos.title: ROYAL HOLY KNIGHTS VS MELA-GALLAND
videos.overview: With Lancelot missing, Galland and Melascula resurrect by fusing together. Outmatched, Percival, Tristan and Gawain need all the help they can get.

videos.title: ADVENT
videos.overview: Drawing strength from the people's hope, Percival faces Mela-Galland, who proves to be too powerful. Tristan takes a dangerous risk to counterattack.

videos.title: THE POWER OF THE KING
videos.overview: King Arthur of Camelot makes a grand entrance and offers an enticing promise to the people of Liones. Later, Arthur and Meliodas cross swords.

videos.title: PREPARED TO PART WAYS
videos.overview: After a restless night, Percival and his companions receive Meliodas's summons to the audience chamber. He asks if they are ready to part ways.

videos.title: GUINEVERE
videos.overview: While the other Knights prepare for their imminent departure, Lancelot has a fateful meeting with Guinevere, who has a unique ability.

videos.title: CONFRONTATION
videos.overview: Guinevere arrives in Camelot just as she's predicted and meets King Arthur. Meanwhile, the Four Knights arrive at their first stop: Wolnack.

videos.title: CITY OF BATTLE
videos.overview: As Percival and the rest enjoy the festivities, Tristan is led away by his new roommate. The group splits up to find him, unaware of the looming danger.

videos.title: FLAMES OF REMINISCENCES
videos.overview: Percival's group might have captured their enemy, but they can't agree on the next step. Elsewhere, Isolde, Anne and Jade face a deadly surprise attack.

videos.title: THE CRAZED KING
videos.overview: While grieving their tragic loss, the Four Knights try to enter Camelot with Teaninich's help but soon discover they must find another way forward.

videos.title: THE SAVIOR
videos.overview: The Four Knights and their companions arrive in the demon realm, where they learn more about Percival's mysterious past, and a touching reunion awaits.

videos.title: BEHEMOTH OF CALAMITY
videos.overview: While Gawain battles Mortlach's group, the other Knights learn about the perilous path ahead: the door to Camelot is on the back of a monstrous beast.

videos.title: WAVERING HEARTS
videos.overview: In preparation for their upcoming quest, Lancelot puts Percival through harsh swordsmanship training. Meanwhile, Schwarz challenges Tristan to a showdown.

videos.title: THE BOY OF DESTINY
videos.overview: After unleashing a new form of his power, Percival continues training with Lancelot. Later, hitchhikers threaten the Knights' quest to find the Behemoth.

videos.title: BANQUET FOR BRAVES
videos.overview: While in a trance, Percival learns the shocking truth behind his existence. Later, the two factions face off in an intense showdown.
